column2: [intro]
I have lots of notebooks, small ones, big ones
They are colorful, and that's encouraging
I take them everywhere, in my backpack
To write down my ideas, it's incredible, it's beautiful
But sometimes I get stuck, inspiration gets blocked
I search for my words, I doodle sketches
But when I find them, oh my, what immense joy
The magic of notebooks, it makes me so happy
There are notebooks with spirals
I turn them around, I feel royal
The lined pages fascinate me, they inspire me
I write my stories, my dreams, my whims
But sometimes I get stuck, inspiration gets blocked
I search for my words, I doodle sketches
But when I find them, oh my, what immense joy
The magic of notebooks, it makes me so happy
[ solo ]
So if you want ideas, if you want to create
Take a notebook and let yourself be carried away
Let your heart speak, let your mind speak
The magic of notebooks is the key to writing.
[ outro ]
